elaine_sales: Quick preflight for Zenith POC — legal wants capacity/security notes. Customer expects ~8k reqs/min peak, ~150 tokens avg. @mike_sre can you confirm reserved GPUs + autoscale 'thermostat' setup? Security questionnaire: https://redwood.example/sq/zenith (they flagged KMS/audit).

mike_sre: For 8k/min @150 tokens that's ~1.2M tokens/min (rough calc). On A100-equivalent throughput that's heavy. Rough ballpark: baseline 3–4 reserved GPUs + 1–2 burst GPUs for short spikes. Need traffic shape to be sure. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

elaine_sales: Traffic shape — daily spike 9:00–9:20 (60% of spike volume), steady ~2k/min otherwise. User messages are short (avg 150 tokens) but lots of small concurrent requests. p99 latency target <200ms.

jordan_infra: Proposed thermostat autoscale pattern to avoid wholesale overprovisioning: keep a small baseline then allow quick short-burst pool. Example policy snippet (for ops runbook):
```
policy: thermostat
baseline_gpus: 3
burst_pool: 2
scale_up_threshold: 70%_gpu_util
scale_up_window: 30s
scale_down_cooldown: 600s
max_gpus: 6
preheat_window: 15m
```
This keeps latency during the 20m spike without paying for full spike all day.

sophia_prod: Also strongly recommend KV-cache prewarm during the preheat window. Add a quick warmup job: `kvwarmup --model=redwood-8b --tokens=200k --concurrency=10`. That cuts cold-starts for prefix-heavy chat.

sam_se: Pricing note: reserved vs burst — 4 reserved GPUs monthly commit vs 3 + burst credits is often close. I'll run numbers and post a simple compare sheet. Security: they want KMS + audit logs + SOC2 clauses. They said VPC is acceptable (no on-prem).

elaine_sales: Legal will ask for SOW with SLA tiers and eviction/fallback plan. Can we capture failure modes succinctly? :warning:

mike_sre: Quick failure-mode list: (1) Spot eviction -> fall back to burst pool/higher-cost hosted; (2) Autoscale lag -> short queueing which degrades p99; (3) Model OOM on extreme sequence lengths -> failover to quantized variant or reject long requests. Recommended mitigations: hedged fallback, small request queue (~100), and model-size limits.

jordan_infra: I'll propose a lightweight queuing + hedged fallback config to include in SOW:
``
max_queue: 120
hedged_fallback: quantized-2b
fallback_latency_target_ms: 500
queue_timeout_ms: 2000
```
Will add to POC runbook and the ops checklist.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled POC preheat job for Zenith at 1820000000 UTC (preheat start). Notifying oncall and ops channel.

elaine_sales: Awesome — can we do a 30-min sync to lock numbers and calendar? I'll send an invite. Thanks all :pray:
